item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 09/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The weather will be windy over the region and dry during the day. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, it will be mainly fine and hot during the day over the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week.

Date/Month: 09/04 (Tuesday)
Wind: North force 3 to 4. East force 5 later, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches.
Temp range: 22 - 25 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
